name: International School for Social and Business Studies
summary: Private faculty in Celje with two bachelor's in economics and business, both taught in Slovene despite the English name.

ib.text: Both bachelor's are taught in Slovene, so the route is for applicants who can study in Slovene; the IB Diploma counts as a Slovenian general matura, and applications go through eVŠ.

notes: Its Economics page says "no tuition fee for full-time study in Slovene" and its Business page "Full-time and part-time study in Slovene language"; neither is on the national English list.
